programs.description: Wang Xuan has to marry Xiao Qi general with a humble background. Together they defeat the rebels and end the border war waged by the Helan clan.
Cheng Zhen, a real estate agent, and her colleague Shao Peng, who conceals his true identity, face challenges as they work with different families, gaining insights into love and life along the way.
Parth and Shorvori, a married couple, try to conceive a child but suffer a miscarriage. However, Teni, a bubbly woman, enters their lives and agrees to become a surrogate mother for their child.
